### Solutions

- **[id 110]**
  - Beatrice ate: $2 \times 24 = 48$ roll-ups.
  - Marcell ate: $3 \times 14 = 42$ roll-ups.
  - Average: $(48 + 42) / 2 = 90 / 2 = 45$.

- **[id 111]**
  - Rowing rate: $20\text{ feet} / 16\text{ seconds} = 1.25\text{ ft/s}$.
  - Shore distance: $64\text{ seconds} \times 1.25\text{ ft/s} = 80\text{ feet}$.
  - Water rate: $2\text{ liters} / 10\text{ feet} = 0.2\text{ liters/ft}$.
  - Total water taken on: $80 \times 0.2 = 16\text{ liters}$.

- **[id 112]**
  - Lessons per day: $4\text{ teachers} \times 2 = 8\text{ lessons}$.
  - Whiteboard cleanings: $8 \times 3 = 24\text{ times}$.

- **[id 113]**
  - Total flowers planted: $2 \times 15 = 30$.
  - Flowers remaining: $30 - 5 = 25$.

- **[id 114]**
  - Brittany's phone capacity: $1800 / 6 = 300\text{ photographs}$.
  - Number of ducks: $300 / 50 = 6\text{ ducks}$.

- **[id 115]**
  - Cost of ten $2 \times 4 \times 10$ boards: $10 \times \$10 = \$100$.
  - Cost of five $4 \times 4 \times 10$ boards: $5 \times \$16 = \$80$.
  - Total original cost: $\$100 + \$80 = \$180$.
  - Profit from 50% price increase: $0.50 \times \$180 = \$90$.

- **[id 116]**
  - Ratio parts: $7 + 13 = 20\text{ parts}$.
  - Size of each part: $120 / 20 = 6$.
  - Teaspoons of sugar: $7 \times 6 = 42$.

- **[id 117]**
  - Total pairs of shoes: $3\text{ children} \times 2\text{ pairs} = 6\text{ pairs}$.
  - Total cost: $6 \times \$60 = \$360$.

- **[id 118]**
  - Vehicles on day 1: $2 \times 5 = 10\text{ vehicles}$.
  - Vehicles imported on day 2: $30 - 10 = 20\text{ vehicles}$.
  - Containers on day 2: $20 / 5 = 4\text{ containers}$.

- **[id 119]**
  - Adrien's salary 4 years ago: $\$40,000$.
  - Adrien's raise (40%): $0.40 \times \$40,000 = \$16,000 \implies \$56,000$.
  - Lylah's salary 4 years ago: $\$40,000 - (0.30 \times \$40,000) = \$28,000$.
  - Lylah's raise (40%): $0.40 \times \$28,000 = \$11,200 \implies \$39,200$.
  - Total combined salary 4 years later: $\$56,000 + \$39,200 = \$95,200$.
